notes: Captions-only packet. Spine: bulk Bi -> exfoliated oxide -> NaBH4 reduction -> metallic 2D Bi -> narrow gap -> NIR absorption -> photothermal and (parallel branch) 660 nm ROS -> joint cause of tumour eradication, bridged by the synergy MEC. Imaging, tumour accumulation and biosafety are side PRF/MEC nodes that support the conclusion. Audits: o2 (oxide (321) reflection left in the bismuthene XRD) and o5 (Bi2O3 still dominates the bismuthene XPS) qualify the 'metallic Bi' identity; l1 bounds the therapy claim (7 W cm-2 laser). Packet problems: packet F4/F5 are paper Figures 5/6 (paper Fig. 4 absent); F3b axis says 421 nm vs caption 470 nm; F5c axis ends at 5 min vs caption 6 min; spurious 'micrograph' cue classes on plots F3d, F3f, F3h, F3i, F5d-F5h, so those readings are cited at figure level; F2h, F2j and F2n carry author-written values not flagged as annotations.
